This policy describes data handling in the ImageToPDF Android application. The current version creates PDFs from images, scans document pages, and creates a PDF copy of one or two sides of the user’s own ID card locally.

• Images and documents, including ID-card images, are processed only locally on the device.
• The app does not send ID-card images, other images, or generated PDFs to the developer or third parties.
• The app does not require registration, create user accounts, display advertising, or use analytics.
• The app does not sell data or share it with advertisers.
• The app manifest does not include the INTERNET permission.

CAMERA is used only after an explicit user action to photograph document pages or ID-card sides. The ID-card scan uses Android Photo Picker to select images without requesting additional media-library access. In other existing flows, the app accesses images only after a system selection or the relevant permission. Processing remains local.

A generated PDF is saved only after the user explicitly selects a location through the Android system dialog. The user then controls that file through the selected storage provider or a file manager.

Original ID-card captures and intermediate copies are kept only in the app’s internal cache. They are deleted after successful export, when the session is cancelled or closed, when a side is replaced or removed, and by time-to-live cleanup. Source-image metadata is not copied into the PDF. The app does not delete source images selected through a system interface.

Users can remove local app data through Android settings or by uninstalling the app. PDFs saved to a user-selected location are not deleted automatically.

PDF files are opened or shared only after a user action through Android system mechanisms. When sharing, the user selects the recipient application. Any subsequent processing is governed by that recipient’s privacy practices.
This policy should be reviewed whenever permissions, dependencies, or data handling change. Privacy questions can be sent to the contact email listed above.
